⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Monotonic per-stream sequence number for a chunk.

Useful for gap detection: a jump greater than 1 between successive rows
(within the same [`components.AudioStreamId`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_stream_id?speculative-link)) surfaces a missing segment
to the viewer without requiring payload inspection.
